name: Infected Host Remediation
description: Remediate and restore a compromised host system to known-good state after malware removal

__hostname__.description: The hostname of the system to remediate

__remediation_ticket__.description: Tracking ticket ID for remediation actions

__recovery_image__.description: Path to clean system recovery image

action--47b83a49-5b67-7567-3060-83949b5b.name: Initiate System Reimage
action--47b83a49-5b67-7567-3060-83949b5b.description: Begin process to reimage compromised system to clean state

action--58c94b5a-6c78-8678-4171-94a5ac6c.name: Restore System Data
action--58c94b5a-6c78-8678-4171-94a5ac6c.description: Restore user data and system files from clean backup

action--69da5c6b-7d89-9789-5282-a5b6bd7d.name: Update Security Software
action--69da5c6b-7d89-9789-5282-a5b6bd7d.description: Install latest security patches, antivirus definitions, and OS updates

commands.command: apt-get update && apt-get upgrade -y && systemctl start clamav-daemon

action--7aea6d7c-8e9a-a89a-6393-b6c7ce8e.name: Re-enable Network Services
action--7aea6d7c-8e9a-a89a-6393-b6c7ce8e.description: Restart critical network services and enable system connectivity

commands.command: systemctl start networking && systemctl start ssh && systemctl start syslog

action--8bfb7e8d-9f0b-b90b-7404-c7d8df9f.name: Verify System Health
action--8bfb7e8d-9f0b-b90b-7404-c7d8df9f.description: Run comprehensive health check to ensure system is operational

commands.command: systemctl status && netstat -tuln | grep LISTEN && df -h

action--9c0c8f9e-a01c-c01c-8515-d8e9e0a0.name: Document Remediation
action--9c0c8f9e-a01c-c01c-8515-d8e9e0a0.description: Create detailed remediation report and close incident ticket

commands.command: Document remediation completion for __hostname__:value in ticket __remediation_ticket__:value

linux--58c94b5a-6c78-8678-4171-94a5ac6c7.name: Remediation Agent
linux--58c94b5a-6c78-8678-4171-94a5ac6c7.description: Linux agent for executing remediation commands

individual--9c0c8f9e-a01c-c01c-8515-d8e9.name: Incident Manager
individual--9c0c8f9e-a01c-c01c-8515-d8e9.description: Manager responsible for incident tracking and closure
